# superset_role (Data Source)

Looks up a role by its name, for example to reference its id in `superset_user.roles` without hard-coding it. The lookup fails when no role has exactly that name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_role" "gamma" {
  name = "Gamma"
}

# The id can be referenced wherever a role id is expected, for example when assigning roles to a user.
resource "superset_user" "analyst" {
  username   = "analyst"
  first_name = "Data"
  last_name  = "Analyst"
  email      = "analyst@example.com"
  password   = "ChangeMe123!"
  roles      = [data.superset_role.gamma.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the role. The comparison is exact.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the role.
